lastCompletedStory.title: Gate the orchestrator boot prompt on worker_isolation and forward configPath at both call sites

nextStoryContext: buildOrchestratorBootPrompt (src/commands/run.ts:225) now gates its 'proceed directly into dispatch' instruction on BOTH readMetaLoop(configPath)==='auto' AND readWorkerIsolation(configPath)==='container', matching the sidecar's own auto-chaining PIN at src/commands/sidecar.ts:2944-2953 (unchanged). Both production call sites (setupPanes in run.ts:588, spawnSetupTmux in setup.ts:551) now forward configPath = join(cwd, 'scripts', 'cam', 'project.toml') instead of calling with no argument -- the CAM-431 seam residue is fully closed at this function's call sites. New behavioral test test/commands/run-boot-prompt-isolation.test.ts proves both sides of the gate against real project.toml fixtures in a real tmpdir. test/run.test.ts's pre-existing meta_loop=auto fixture (writeMetaLoopToml helper) was extended with an optional workerIsolation param and the 'auto' case now writes worker_isolation='container' explicitly. Corrected a stale comment in test/commands/run-model-resolution.test.ts that claimed readBackend had no configPath seam (it does, src/config/models.ts:224). File-size ceilings raised (with CAM-455 tracker ref in the budget's _ref) for src/commands/run.ts (1165->1168), src/commands/setup.ts (881->885), and test/run.test.ts (1112->1122) -- all three grew directly from this story's edits. No sidecar.ts behavior was touched (that file's auto-chaining gate remains the single source of truth this story only aligned the prompt to).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal TypeScript refactor: gates an existing prompt-builder on config keys already read elsewhere in the codebase (readMetaLoop/readWorkerIsolation, both backed by Bun's built-in Bun.TOML.parse, previously validated in an earlier story per src/config/toml.ts's own header comment). No new external library or API surface introduced.
